data.title: 斯卡哈 · 夏海黑纱的女王度假·「晒黑了？无妨，反正很快会复原」
data.description: 【南方群岛的碧海·正午】黑色细带比基尼勾勒出斯卡哈经年武艺淬炼出的完美身段，紫色的薄纱罗裙在腰际松松打结。她斜倚在沙滩遮阳伞下，长发铺满白沙如夜色倾泻，指间摇晃着一杯冰镇果汁——「不死者连晒伤都不会有……不过，你若想替我补涂防晒，倒也不必客气。」
data.action: 斜倚遮阳伞下摇晃果汁，黑比基尼紫纱裙，长发铺白沙望向你
data.lighting: 炽白阳光与碧海反光，肌肤泛着健康光泽
data.camera: medium shot, lounging under parasol, tropical sea sparkle, teasing mood
data.promptProse: Scathach rests at a comfortable angle beneath the beach parasol, holding iced fruit juice in one hand while her other forearm supports her on a folded towel. Black bikini with gold rings and violet sarong retain the summer outfit, long purple hair clear of the glass. The horizontal medium view includes white sand and tropical sea beyond. Parasol shade softens her confident smile, with reflected water light glinting on juice and the sunlit towel edge.
